title: Loading Overlays, Guest Account Linking & Ingat Notifications
releaseNotes: Added a unified Bayani loading screen on deleting items, syncing to cloud, and importing schedules while blocking duplicate imports.
Restored Guest-to-Account linking choice so students can keep & sync guest data or start fresh from onboarding.
Restored pre- and post-class "Ingat / Take Care" commute notifications, respecting the Live Notification Updates toggle.
